convertibility_reason: Uses two iCustom indicators ('MA Cross 3MACross Alert WarnSig' and 'price_channel') for signal generation and auto SL/TP. Although the underlying indicators are three MAs and a price channel, the EA reads signals from custom compiled .ex5 indicators via iCustom handles, requiring manual recreation of these custom indicators in Python. The standard library includes (Trade\*.mqh, MoneyFixedMargin.mqh) are MT5 framework helpers, not trading logic dependencies.

derived_values.name: ExtStopLoss - adjusted stop loss in price units
derived_values.formula: InpStopLoss * m_adjusted_point where m_adjusted_point = _Point * 10 if Digits==5 or Digits==3, else _Point
derived_values.used_by: Entry SL/TP calculation and trailing stop

derived_values.name: ExtTakeProfit - adjusted take profit in price units
ExtTrailingStop - adjusted trailing stop in price units
ExtBreakEven - adjusted breakeven distance in price units
derived_values.used_by: Auto SL/TP fallback and BreakEven logic

derived_values.name: Auto SL for long - channel lower or BreakEven-based
derived_values.formula: ch_dn if ch_dn < Ask - ExtBreakEven else Ask - ExtBreakEven

derived_values.name: Auto TP for long - channel upper or BreakEven-based
derived_values.formula: ch_up if ch_up > Ask + ExtBreakEven else Ask + ExtBreakEven

derived_values.name: Auto SL for short - channel upper or BreakEven-based
derived_values.formula: ch_up if ch_up > Bid + ExtBreakEven else Bid + ExtBreakEven

derived_values.name: Auto TP for short - channel lower or BreakEven-based
derived_values.formula: ch_dn if ch_dn < Bid - ExtBreakEven else Bid - ExtBreakEven

params.auto_mode: uses Price Channel lower (long) or upper (short) when InpAutoSLTP=true, else BreakEven distance when InpAutoSLTP=false and InpBreakEven>0
uses Price Channel upper (long) or lower (short) when InpAutoSLTP=true

other_exits: BreakEven exit: moves SL to open price +/- ExtBreakEven when price moves ExtBreakEven+ExtTrailingStep in profit (only when TrailingStop==0 and AutoSLTP==false and BreakEven>0)
Auto SL/TP trailing: moves long SL up to ch_dn when ch_dn > current SL, moves short SL down to ch_up when ch_up < current SL (only when TrailingStop==0 and AutoSLTP==true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If InpLots > 0, use fixed lots (InpLots). If InpLots <= 0, use CMoneyFixedMargin with Risk percent of free margin to calculate lot size.

custom_logic_notes: Three mutually exclusive exit management modes: (1) TrailingStop>0 activates fixed-pip trailing stop with step; (2) AutoSLTP=true uses Price Channel levels as dynamic SL/TP that trail with the channel; (3) BreakEven>0 (with both others off) moves SL to breakeven+step once profit exceeds BreakEven distance. Signal comes from custom '3MACross' indicator which internally computes three SMMA crossovers (periods 23/61/122). Price Channel (period 15) is used for auto SL/TP placement and trailing. Entry on bar index TradeBar (1 if TradeAtCloseBar=true, 0 otherwise). Max 5 positions per side allowed. Opposite-side positions are closed before entering new direction.
python_conversion_notes: The three SMMA indicators can be recreated in Python using pandas ewm with alpha=1/(period+1) for SMMA equivalent, or talib.SMA with manual smoothing. The Price Channel is a simple highest-high/lowest-low over 15 periods. The crossover signal logic from the custom 3MACross indicator must be reverse-engineered: it likely triggers when fast MA crosses medium MA while both are above/below slow MA. The three exit management modes (trailing, auto channel-based, breakeven) must be implemented as a switch. The CMoneyFixedMargin lot calculation uses Risk% of free margin divided by margin required per lot - must replicate or use a fixed-fraction approach. Digit adjustment (multiply pips by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled. TradeAtCloseBar flag means signals are read from bar[1] (previous closed bar), not bar[0].
